name: The Postman
source:
You're the pilot. She's the stowaway. The ship won’t make it with both of you aboard.

An interactive re-telling of Tom Godwin's 1954 short story "The Cold Equations".

[From [url=https://funderful.itch.io/postman]Itch.io[/url]]
